b5847d2421e6f4cd164bcf4aa704f50fb0e422e7.summary: Protection bulletin from Broadcom's Symantec security center describing SVCStealer, a new C++ infostealer identified in the wild. It collects system information, credentials, cryptocurrency wallets, browser data, screenshots and data from messaging or VPN apps, compresses it into a zip archive and extracts it to attacker-controlled C2 servers. The bulletin lists detection names across Symantec, Carbon Black and WebPulse products.
